description: This file defines a TypeScript class 'CloseCom' for interacting with the Close.com API, including types for data structures, API methods, and query builders. It manages authentication via API key or OAuth, and includes methods for contacts, leads, activities, and custom fields.

classes.name: CloseCom
classes.description: A class to communicate with Close.com APIs, supporting OAuth and API key authentication, with methods for managing contacts, leads, activities, and custom fields.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the CloseCom instance with API key and options, setting up logging and authentication parameters.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers for API requests, handling OAuth token refresh if needed.

methods.name: shouldRefreshToken
methods.description: Determines if the OAuth token needs to be refreshed based on expiry time.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth access token using refresh token, updates stored credentials in database.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches current user info from Close.com API.

methods.name: contact.search
methods.description: Searches for contacts by email addresses.

methods.name: contact.create
methods.description: Creates a new contact with given person info and lead ID.

methods.name: contact.update
methods.description: Updates an existing contact by contact ID.

methods.name: contact.delete
methods.description: Deletes a contact by contact ID.

methods.name: lead.list
methods.description: Lists leads based on query.

methods.name: lead.status
methods.description: Retrieves lead statuses.

methods.name: lead.update
methods.description: Updates a lead by ID.

methods.name: lead.create
methods.description: Creates a new lead.

methods.name: lead.delete
methods.description: Deletes a lead by ID.

methods.name: customActivity.type.create
methods.description: Creates a custom activity type.

methods.name: customActivity.type.get
methods.description: Retrieves custom activity types.

methods.name: customField.activity.create
methods.description: Creates a custom activity field.

methods.name: customField.activity.get
methods.description: Retrieves custom activity fields.

methods.name: customField.contact.create
methods.description: Creates a custom contact field.

methods.name: customField.contact.get
methods.description: Retrieves custom contact fields.

methods.name: customField.shared.get
methods.description: Retrieves shared custom fields.

methods.name: activity.custom.create
methods.description: Creates a custom activity.

methods.name: activity.custom.delete
methods.description: Deletes a custom activity by UUID.

methods.name: activity.custom.update
methods.description: Updates a custom activity by UUID.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Internal method to perform GET requests.

methods.name: _post
methods.description: Internal method to perform POST requests.

methods.name: _put
methods.description: Internal method to perform PUT requests.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Internal method to perform DELETE requests.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs the actual HTTP request with headers, method, and body.
